objective.statement: Automate the EMC verification workflow without changing or discarding original measurement evidence.

priorities.text: Preserve original measurement evidence and traceability.
Send uncertain decisions to human review.

constraints.text: Raw measurement evidence must not be overwritten or discarded.
Uncertain automated decisions must go to human review.

forbidden_scope.text: Do not make final decisions fully autonomous when the evidence is uncertain.

success_criteria.text: Manual repetitive verification effort is reduced.
Uncertain cases are routed to human review.
